article.title: Class Podcast
article.author: Housing Justice Commission
article.content: Let’s ETOC: HJC on the Class podcast! HJC Steering Committee members, Sebastian of Triangle DSA and Triangle Tenants Union, and Kelly of Boston DSA join the crew of the National Political Education Committee’s own Class podcast. They discuss the Emergency Tenant Organizing Committee (ETOC) and the exciting rise of tenant unionization on the socialist left. How does it fit into the broader scope of working class organizing for the crucial fight for decent housing? Listen here and find out! Apple podcast link NPEC Class Podcast link
